assertions.name: no_i2_probe_only_witnesses
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = every probe is consumed somewhere)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every probe witness is consumed by production OR is named as upstream by a downstream witness.

description: I2 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: every *.witness.json with a label-shaped `contentBlock` is checked for references from the production-consumer set (paper_six_term_isotope_sweep, derive_m_p/n, atomic_mass_via_rho_k, mass_table_ppb, canonical_tr_m_via_rust, cross_check_trM_*) and from other witnesses' `upstream_witness_hashes`.  Unreferenced witnesses are I2 probe-only shelf pieces.
